prompt_text:
what time is it on the clock in the upper right of the monitor?

Provide a detailed explanation of about 100 to 160 words, using the image and the question to support your answer. Do not invent details that are not visible or supported by the question. End with exactly one final line in the format "Final answer: <answer>", replacing <answer> with a single word or short phrase. Put that final answer on a separate line, with no text after it.
